title: NS Clipper v1.1.6 — Production Release
changelog:
• Multi-Person Group Mode with RetinaFace + MediaPipe dual-tracking (98-99% accuracy)
• Complete elimination of duplicate faces across shot cuts and dark studio backgrounds
• Enhanced scene-cut detection (HSV histogram + grayscale difference > 20.0)
• Autonomous Project Session Isolation (independent project folders, zero clip bleed)
• Meaningful AI fallback titles and detailed error logging (HTTP 429, timestamps)
• Zero-config offline deployment with bundled MediaPipe, RetinaFace, and YuNet weights
